title: Sharia-Compliance Workbook — Case Result v1 (LOCKED schema)
description: Pure deterministic output of evaluate(case_input, rule_pack). Five closed verdict tokens. Every fired rule yields exact trigger evidence: the exact matched substring plus its Unicode code-point offsets in the ORIGINAL input text. No timestamps here (run metadata lives in the attestation) so results are byte-reproducible.

sha256.description: sha256 of canonical pack JSON, recomputed at load and asserted.

verdict_token.description: LOCKED closed set of exactly five tokens. Semantics: compliant = all applicable rules evaluated, none fired, inputs sufficient; non_compliant = at least one blocking rule fired with verified citations; doubtful = advisory/contested rule fired, or any firing rule cites an unverified source (downgrade); out_of_coverage = no pack rule applies to the item's domain/structure; insufficient_input = required guided fields empty or free text yields no confirmed item.

verdict_proposed.description: Engine output. This is a WORKSHEET PROPOSAL, never an approval.

confirmed_by_operator.description: True only after the human operator confirms/corrects the item (free-text mode requires confirmation; guided items are confirmed at entry).

verdict_recorded.description: Null until the operator records the worksheet verdict. The engine NEVER sets this. It is the human's field.

unverified_findings.description: Fired rules whose citations are all-or-partially unverified are ALSO mirrored here with their citation status, so the unverified pathway is visible even when the main evidence carries a downgrade. Never contributes to 'non_compliant'.

limits_applied.description: Machine-readable limit codes applied to this item, e.g. 'no_stemming_ar', 'blocking_requires_verified_citation', 'single_run_scope'.

type.description: Guided-mode term evidence: the item's declared term_ids matched a rule; no input text or offsets exist.

surface_form.description: The exact lexicon surface form that matched (en or ar).

match_text.description: Exact matched substring from the input, logical order.

start_offset.description: Unicode code-point offset into the original input text.

end_offset.description: Exclusive end; end > start; end-start == len(match_text) in code points.
